entities.name: Margot Duhalde Sotomayor
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Margot Duhalde Sotomayor was a Chilean pilot who served with the Air Transport Auxiliary in World War II. She was Chile's first female military pilot and first female air traffic controller, and the last living Chilean veteran of the war.
